arm_definitions.pairnf_z40: control: BT vs incumbent pick, every passing better/worse pair weight 1 (pair_nf); CV cells copied from H473 (= H472/H471 cells)
arm_definitions.pgap_z40: H473 reference: pair weight gap^1, gap = |t_j - t_inc| / spread_c, renormalized to mean 1 per context; CV cells copied from H473
arm_definitions.pgap2_z40: dose: pair weight gap^2 (pgap = 2.0), renormalized to mean 1 per context
arm_definitions.pgapa2_z40: stack: pgap = 1.0 + 2 x 1,024-context gradient accumulation (accum = 2; extra micro-batch on the H467 acc2 keyed streams); 2x per-step compute
arm_definitions.shared: 16 steps, lr 3e-4, slate 192, keep 48, same pointwise/listwise/hinge terms, z >= 0.40 gate, rng_arm = pairnf (all random streams shared)

primary_metric: median over seeds of pooled OOF Elo vs incumbent with 95% family-bootstrap CI; non-floor Elo co-primary
selection: max mean non-floor OOF Elo over partitions (tie: pooled gain)
strict: pooled gain > 0.002 and CI low > 0; Elo > 0 and CI low > 0; non-floor Elo CI low > 0; Elo > 0 per partition; paired family-bootstrap arm-control CI low > 0; ties never win
lift_rule: a non-control arm passes strict and beats the control (paired CI low > 0) on every seed, val91 not_worse on every seed, median val91 gain with cross-seed family-bootstrap CI low > 0, clean red-team; otherwise NO_LIFT
secondary: paired comparison vs pgap_z40 (aggregator re-run with CTRL=pgap_z40): a new arm that beats the control but not pgap is reported as pgap-equivalent, not as a new lever
redteam_prereg: floor-recovery split: report gain with and without -2.0 floor recoveries; a paired NON-FLOOR gain CI > 0 vs control is the mechanism test (val91 has 0 incumbent floors, so a floor-only edge cannot reach LIFT)
dose-response: pgap2 vs pgap vs control floor recoveries and non-floor gain; non-monotone => no dose evidence
stacking: pgapa2 vs pgap and vs H467 acc2 (control-relative) effect sizes; additive, sub-additive or none
mechanism: non-floor W/L of each arm's extra kept changes and of the control changes it drops
kept < 0.5x control => gate-starved; kept > 2x control => z-inflated; gap^2 concentrates weight on a few pairs per context (report kept counts and median |z|)
compute confound: pgapa2 does 2x per-step work; a win must be checked against the control-relative acc2 effect from H467

control and pgap CV cells copied from H473 fold_sig (sha256 lists); fresh re-check in smoke (control 8d5ac793, pgap 1afa7d46 for h452a fold 0 seed 1) and probe (control full sha 5f3acc50, pgap 4c2e17f9)
ties never win; val91 gain ~0 with >= 85/91 ties is not evidence; report single-context val91 drivers (H472/H473: idx 41)
equal pooled Elo with equal W-L = arithmetic coincidence once adapters differ
pair weights use training-fold fitness only; val91 read once per seed for the selected arm only

control_cells_reused_from_h473.sha256_list: control_fold_sig_from_h473.sha256 (in scratch dir; hashes identical to H473 control_fold_sig_from_h472.sha256)

launch.order: probe + smoke together (launch_probe_smoke.sh) -> chain_waiter.sh (waits for the smoke pid; launches waiter.sh only if smoke.log has 4 arm CV lines and no Traceback/Error) -> waiter.sh
launch.own_guard: abort at MemAvailable < 15 GB; waiter relaunches (max 5 per seed), resume-safe via results/fold_sig
